### Task 33a: identity coverage — three things the envelope claims to cover and does not


**THE AUDIT DOCUMENTS ARE COMMITTED — READ THEM, DO NOT WORK FROM THIS SUMMARY.** Each finding below
names its gate and its number; the full claim, the reproduced evidence with file:line, and the
gate's proposed fix live in `docs/audits/quant/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md`,
`docs/audits/stress/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md` and
`docs/audits/data/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md`. This mandate deliberately does NOT re-transcribe
them — a mandate that retypes its evidence is a transcription channel, and this arc has paid for
that lesson more than once. Where the seat OVERRIDES a gate's proposed fix, it says so explicitly
below and the seat's ruling wins.


**Findings: data F1 (HIGH), quant F4 (MED), stress F2 (MED).**

The identity envelope's whole claim is that a red is ATTRIBUTABLE to data-vs-code. Run 30 widened
`source_hashes` from 3 inputs to 12 and that was real progress, but the gates found three things
still outside identity — and one of them answers the seat's own question, "can two runs over
different upstream bytes emit the same artifact identity?", with **YES**:

- **data F1 — the CPM mortality basis is outside artifact identity.** It is the sole source of every
  q value the supply side rides on. Two runs over different upstream mortality tables emit different
  `rankings.json` bytes under a BYTE-IDENTICAL envelope. Note the constraint the gate flags: spec §2
  forbids private reach-ins, so `mortality._DATA_DIR` is off limits — the digest has to be computed
  through the §2-sanctioned PUBLIC surface.
- **quant F4 — the ruled immigrant inputs sit outside BOTH identity tokens.** These are the headship
  and ownership-ratio pairs that amendments #13/#14 exist to govern, so **a ruled value can move and
  re-mint nothing.** That is the citation-coupling chain failing at the artifact boundary, which is
  the same failure §6→P8→join-table was built to prevent one layer up.
- **stress F2 — two uncited model literals on the money path swing the shipped headline `mean_ed_*`
  numbers by 55-66%** and neither is covered by `assumptions_hash`, so editing either moves every
  emitted number under a byte-identical identity. (Ranking ORDER survived in all six of the gate's
  legs; the MAGNITUDES do not.)

**Prefer the fix that closes the uncited-literal half and the identity half in ONE move** — lifting a
literal into `CENTRAL_ASSUMPTIONS` with a `CENTRAL_PROVENANCE` entry does both, because
`assumptions_hash` then covers it. Where a value genuinely cannot be cited, say so in its provenance
entry rather than inventing an anchor: **an honest `uncited` marker beats a fabricated citation**,
and this arc has removed several fabricated ones.

**THIS TASK RE-MINTS THE GOLDEN BY CONSTRUCTION** — widening identity changes the envelope, which
changes both documents' bytes. Do NOT regenerate the committed golden here; task 3 owns that, once.
Expect `tests/test_golden.py` to RED at the end of this task and leave it red — say so plainly in
your report rather than papering it.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING — the seat commits at run close after its own diff review. RED-first binds. Run-unique scratchpad subdir; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for mutation batteries; probe on COPIES and never disable a guard in the live tree. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail, figures derived from that run and never transcribed.

tasks.title: Task 33b — three producer/contract seams (non-finite band RULED a terminal), dead guard, one-sided envelope
tasks.instructions:
### Task 33b: three contract seams, a dead guard, and an envelope that is centred wrong


**THE AUDIT DOCUMENTS ARE COMMITTED — READ THEM, DO NOT WORK FROM THIS SUMMARY.** Each finding below
names its gate and its number; the full claim, the reproduced evidence with file:line, and the
gate's proposed fix live in `docs/audits/quant/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md`,
`docs/audits/stress/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md` and
`docs/audits/data/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md`. This mandate deliberately does NOT re-transcribe
them — a mandate that retypes its evidence is a transcription channel, and this arc has paid for
that lesson more than once. Where the seat OVERRIDES a gate's proposed fix, it says so explicitly
below and the seat's ruling wins.


**Findings: data F2 (HIGH), stress F3/F4/F6/F7/F8 (MED/LOW), quant F3 (MED).**

**data F2 — THE THIRD PRODUCER/CONTRACT SEAM, and the SEAT HAS RULED IT. Do not pick.**
`evaluate_indicator` emits an UNKNOWN(`malformed_band`) record carrying the offending NON-FINITE
endpoint, and its own `assert_tripwire_record_valid` REJECTS exactly that record — four of five
malformed-band sub-cases die at the contract boundary with a bare `ValueError` instead of the UNKNOWN
§7c mandates. The gate offered two options and correctly refused to choose.

**RULED: option (b) — a NON-FINITE band is a RUN-LEVEL TERMINAL, not an UNKNOWN record.** The
reasoning, so you can check it rather than take it: the band is the CALLER's, injected, so a
non-finite band is a caller/config defect — deterministic, independent of the feed — which is exactly
the shape of a run-level terminal and not of a per-indicator UNKNOWN. **The module already ruled the
sibling case this way:** `_band_endpoints` raises a named terminal for a NON-COERCIBLE endpoint
because it "cannot ride the record's float-typed band fields". A non-finite endpoint cannot ride them
either, under §7's `allow_nan=False`. Option (a) would send two near-identical defects down opposite
paths and would cost TWO spec amendments to accommodate a caller defect.

**The FINITE inversion case (`lo > hi`) KEEPS its UNKNOWN(`malformed_band`)** — it is serializable,
and §7c's "inverted band → UNKNOWN" stays exactly true. **The seat authors spec amendment #17 at
fold, in the same commit as your code** (the #15/#16 pattern). You implement the code and the seam
test; you do NOT touch the spec and you do NOT add a `Reason` member.

**Pin all three seams with the amendment-#16 test SHAPE, generalized:** assert that EVERY record each
producer can emit validates against its contract validator, parametrized over the full sub-case set.
That is the shape that would have caught all three of this arc's seams, and it is worth more than any
individual fix here.

- **stress F4** — a coercible-STRING band verdicts GREEN on the `demoflow tripwires` path while the
  emit path CRASHES on the record the producer built, and the non-finite sibling correctly returns
  UNKNOWN. Two verification paths disagreeing, **and the green one is the cheap one.**
- **stress F3 — `NULLABLE_REASONS` has no exact-membership pin**; two non-members can be ADDED and
  all 1,097 tests pass, which would reintroduce amendment #16's seam in the opposite direction and
  ship CI-green. **Take the gate's fix, not a fourth frozenset copy:** make it a PROPERTY over every
  Reason a producer can actually emit.
- **stress F6 — the rankings row TYPE contract has exactly one enforcement point on the emit path and
  that call site is deletion-survivable**: delete it, all 1,097 tests pass, and `rank_stable: 1`,
  `rank: -3`, `mean_ed_reference: true` all ship. Give the contract one owner ON the write path.
- **stress F7** — `_fixed_keys`' undeclared-node refusal is unreachable dead code carrying a
  live-sounding claim about §7's closed-schema rule. Delete it or reach it; **do not leave a claim
  standing over code that cannot run.**
- **stress F8** — "EMISSION IS ALL-OR-NOTHING" over-claims: validation is, the WRITES are a
  sequential loop, so an I/O failure on the second document leaves a mismatched-identity pair on
  disk. Either make it true (temp-file + rename) or narrow the claim to what holds.
- **quant F3 / stress F9 — the suppression envelope is centred where the arithmetic is not.**
  `±2.5·n_cells` is published as "±(rounding + suppression)", but a `--` cell contributes 0 and its
  true contribution is [0, +5] — one-sided. The rounding leg is right; the suppression leg is not.
  **The strongest argument is internal: the same module already models the suppressed cell correctly
  one-sided, one constant away, at the degenerate floor.**

tasks.title: Task 33c — wire all five sweep axes, rank_stable from the union, re-mint the golden once
tasks.instructions:
### Task 33c: wire the robustness sweep the spec and constants already declare, and re-mint the golden


**THE AUDIT DOCUMENTS ARE COMMITTED — READ THEM, DO NOT WORK FROM THIS SUMMARY.** Each finding below
names its gate and its number; the full claim, the reproduced evidence with file:line, and the
gate's proposed fix live in `docs/audits/quant/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md`,
`docs/audits/stress/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md` and
`docs/audits/data/2026-07-21-demoflow-tranche1.md`. This mandate deliberately does NOT re-transcribe
them — a mandate that retypes its evidence is a transcription channel, and this arc has paid for
that lesson more than once. Where the seat OVERRIDES a gate's proposed fix, it says so explicitly
below and the seat's ruling wins.


**Finding: quant F1 / stress F1 (CRITICAL, both gates independently, and the SEAT REPRODUCED IT).**

`rank_stable: true` ships on all eight rows of the committed golden as a verdict over **ONE of FIVE
declared axes**. `_rank_stability` iterates only `SWEEP_GRID["q_live_per_year"]`; `SWEEP_GRID`
declares FOUR; and `constants.py:229-232` states as FACT that a fifth exists — "Task 29 perturbs the
join table with a uniform override spanning `CONSTANTS["immigrant_ownership_ratio_sweep_span"]` =
[0.155, 1.033]". **No such code exists anywhere in the tree.**

**THE SEAT'S OWN REPRODUCTION, so you know the target rather than trusting a report.** Out-of-tree
harness patching `resolve_immigrant_inputs` at the public entry point; validity established first by
confirming the unpatched central run reproduces the committed `rankings.json` EXACTLY:

- uniform ratio **0.155 → 8 of 8 geographies change rank, and every mean ED FLIPS SIGN** (HORS_RMR
  1→4, LAVAL_RA13 4→1, MTL_RMR 6→2, MTL_ISLAND_RA06 8→5, QC_RMR 7→8, MONTEREGIE 5→3, LAURENTIDES
  2→6, LANAUDIERE 3→7);
- uniform ratio **1.033 → 4 of 8 change rank**;
- **union over both declared endpoints: every row moves.**

**BUILD IT: iterate EVERY declared `SWEEP_GRID` axis at both endpoints, PLUS the join-table ratio
override over `CONSTANTS["immigrant_ownership_ratio_sweep_span"]`, and set `rank_stable` from the
UNION.** The honest result is `false` on all eight rows — **that is the correct output, not a
regression, and you must not treat the flip as something to avoid.**

**A named obstacle the gate diagnosed, so you do not rediscover it:** `cohort/listings.py:73`
hard-binds the module-level `PHI_VOLUNTARY` INSIDE `market_listings`, unlike `lag` and
`eventual_fraction` which are already parameters. That is very likely why three axes were dropped
rather than swept. **Parameterize it** — do not reach for a module reload inside production code.

**Cost is real and it is yours to manage:** the sweep already runs the ED grid 4× per pipeline call
and this makes it ~11×. The demoflow suite is already ~2m48s. Use a session-scoped fixture, or make
the sweep's leg count configurable with the FULL set as the committed default — **but the committed
golden must be minted from the full sweep, never a reduced one.** If you cannot get the runtime
acceptable, STOP and report; do not quietly ship a narrower sweep, because a narrower sweep is
exactly the defect this task exists to close.

**RE-MINT THE GOLDEN, once, at the end** — tasks 1 and 2 have already changed the envelope and left
`tests/test_golden.py` red. Use the committed generation path (`scripts/gen_golden.py`), not a
hand-run. Update `demoflow/artifacts/README.md` to record that `rank_stable` is now a five-axis
verdict and that `false` everywhere is the measured state.

**ORDERING NOTE, stated honestly as a precaution rather than a measurement:** this task is last
because tasks 1 and 2 change the envelope and the record contract, so a golden minted before them
would be re-minted anyway. Run 31 taught the seat to say which of those it has actually measured —
here it has NOT measured the byte deltas of tasks 1 and 2, and is sequencing on the reasoning
alone.
